author: Artem
text: Last year I discovered a new kind of holiday — yachting. It became a new holiday format for me. The sea, the freedom to move between coves and marinas. Breakfasts and dinners under the open sky. Jumping off the yacht into the sea. How the plumbing and the cabins inside are set up. Now I have one more active hobby. Life has become more interesting and more fun 😃 Thank you to Sofa for organising the trip so wonderfully and for bringing fun people together around her!
